movie_title: What is hysteria, and why were so many women diagnosed with it? - Mark S. Micale

vocabulary.definition: exaggerated or uncontrollable emotion or excitement, especially among a group of people
vocabulary.example: The news of the celebrity's arrival caused mass hysteria among the fans waiting outside.
The dictator's contemptible actions towards his people led to widespread protests.

vocabulary.definition: showing hatred, dislike, or mistrust of women
vocabulary.example: The company's policy was criticized for being misogynistically biased against promoting women to leadership positions.

vocabulary.definition: to penetrate or gain entrance to gradually or stealthily
vocabulary.example: The spy successfully infiltrated the enemy's headquarters without raising any suspicion.

vocabulary.definition: to make (something) seem less important, significant, or complex than it really is
vocabulary.example: The media's coverage of the environmental crisis was criticized for trivializing the severity of the situation.

vocabulary.definition: kept under control, restrained, or suppressed
vocabulary.example: Her repressed emotions resurfaced during the therapy session, leading to a breakthrough in her healing process.
